# Victoria Dawn Black

> Actor, dramaturg, and creative producer working across theatre and film. Collage artist. Executive Director of Montani StageLab. Also credited as Victoria Black.

- Training: BFA in Acting, minor in Spanish, The University of Memphis, magna cum laude. Scene study at The 4th Wall Acting Studio, Nashville.
- Stats: she/her, non-union, 5'6", mezzo (A3 to C6).
- Skills: IPA for dialects (Irish, RP, Southern), Spanish (intermediate), mask and commedia dell'arte, rapier and dagger, costume construction.
- Open to: stage and screen roles, dramaturgy, producing, arts leadership, and costume construction.

## Credits

- Film: Just Play (lead, dir. Misha Bondarenko), Chipper (supporting, dir. MK Kopp), Eat Your Heart Out (feature, dir. Alex Copper)
- Theatre: As It Is in Heaven (Hannah), The Mousetrap (Mrs. Boyle), As You Like It musical adaptation (Court Ensemble, Hisperia u/s), Twelfth Night (Antonia u/s, Sebastia u/s), Spoon River Anthology (Flossie, Margaret, Mrs. Williams), all at The University of Memphis
- Readings: Chatterbox (Younger Deena), Black Flag (Narrator)
- Devised: Hills and Hollers (Cassie, Seraphine)
